# RBTray

## Status

> [!NOTE]
> RBTray is currently in maintenance mode, meaning no new features will be added,
> but bugs may be fixed if reported.

## Overview

RBTray is a small Windows program that runs in the background and allows windows
to be minimized to the system tray by:

- Right-clicking its minimize button
- Shift-right-clicking its title bar
- Using the Control-Alt-Down hotkey

Not all of these methods will work for every window, so please use whichever
method works best for your needs. Also note that some types of windows can not
be properly minimized at all, most notably Windows Store application windows
such as WhatsApp.

RBTray is free, open source, and is distributed under the terms of the [GNU
General Public Licence](http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html).

An offline two-password authenticator (TOTP / HOTP / Steam), in one repository with two apps:

| Folder | App | Stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`android/`](android) | Android 8.0+ (API 26+) | Kotlin, Jetpack Compose |
| [`desktop/`](desktop) | Linux and Windows | Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform (JVM) |

Both apps use the same vault/backup formats, so a backup exported on the phone restores
on the desktop and vice versa. Every start asks for two independent app passwords; codes
are computed locally and no account data leaves the device.

security and format notes.

items.description: GreenTunnel is an anti-censorship utility designed to bypass the DPI system that is put in place by various ISPs to block access to certain websites.
items.readme_snippet:
# Green Tunnel

GreenTunnel bypasses DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) systems found in many ISPs (Internet Service Providers) which block access to certain websites. It runs a local proxy that splits the TLS ClientHello so the hostname you are visiting never appears whole in a single packet, and resolves DNS over an encrypted channel so your resolver cannot be used to block or observe you either. > **Note:** GreenTunnel does not hide your IP address and is not a VPN. It defeats hostname-based blocking, nothing more. ---

# proxyharvest

**زبان‌ها:** [فارسی](README.md) · [English](README.en.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [中文](README.zh.md)

ابزار خط فرمان Go برای جمع‌آوری پروکسی‌های رایگان از رجیستری داخلی سایت‌ها (داخل کد)، تست واقعی آن‌ها از اتصال مستقیم و مرتب‌سازی بر اساس سرعت.

باینری‌های ایستا برای Linux و Windows (amd64/arm64) در صفحهٔ [Releases](https://github.com/FossilizedProgrammer/proxyharvest/releases) منتشر می‌شوند — خود گیتهاب با Actions آن‌ها را از همین سورس می‌سازد.

## ساخت

```bash
go build -o proxyharvest .
```

## استفاده

```bash
# همه سایت‌ها، همه کشورها، خروجی پیش‌فرض proxies.txt
./proxyharvest

# فقط پروکسی‌های آمریکا، ۲۰ مورد سریع‌تر
./proxyharvest -country US -top 20 -out us.txt

# فقط HTTP و SOCKS5
./proxyharvest -types http,socks5

# نشان دادن جزئیات هر منبع (موفق/ناموفق، تعداد، پروکسی‌های جایگزین)
./proxyharvest -v
```

`-country` کد دوحرفی ISO می‌گیرد (مثل `US`، `DE`، `IR`).

## English

### What is AntiRegister?

In many countries a phone that is not *registered* (IMEI registration) can't use a local SIM card. Many people end up carrying **two phones**: a registered one that holds the SIM, and the phone they actually want to use every day.

**AntiRegister connects those two phones over Bluetooth**, so you can use your daily phone for the things your SIM phone receives, without constantly picking up the second one.

- **SIM Phone** – the registered phone with your SIM card. It stays in your bag or at home.
- **Main Phone** – the phone you actually use. It shows and sends your messages through the SIM Phone.
